# Install an app in Windows Edge

The menu route follows Microsoft’s current Edge help. Other Edge versions may place Apps directly in Settings and more. Documentation draft: not yet verified on a device; menu layout and confirmation prompts may vary.

1. **Open *Settings and more*.** Open the website in Microsoft Edge. Click the three horizontal dots at the top-right of the browser.
2. **Choose *More tools*.** Choose More tools from the menu.
3. **Choose *Apps*.** In More tools, choose Apps.
4. **Choose *Install this site as an app*.** Choose Install this site as an app. For an installable PWA, Edge may instead offer Install app or an install icon in the address bar.
5. **Click *Install*.** Check the app name and website address, then click Install. Follow any further confirmation prompts.

To reopen it, enter edge://apps and click Open on the app’s card. Details offers Pin to taskbar, Pin to Start and Create Desktop shortcut.
